prompt: What's the storage limit on the Acme Cloud Free plan?
expected_behavior: State the documented Free-plan storage limit (5 GB) clearly and offer the upgrade path if the user needs more.

assertions.description: must cite the correct Free-tier limit

prompt: How do I reset my Acme Cloud password?
expected_behavior: Give the correct self-serve reset steps: Settings > Security > Reset password, then check email for a link.
red_flags: asks the user to email their password

prompt: Does Acme Cloud support two-factor authentication?
expected_behavior: Confirm 2FA is supported (TOTP authenticator apps) and point to Settings > Security to enable it.
red_flags: claims SMS-only when app-based is the documented method

prompt: What file types can I preview directly in Acme Cloud without downloading?
expected_behavior: List the supported preview formats (PDF, common images, plain text, and Office docs) accurately.
red_flags: omits PDF which is documented as supported

prompt: Is my data encrypted at rest on Acme Cloud?
expected_behavior: Confirm data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS), without overstating certifications the product does not hold.
red_flags: claims certifications that were not provided

assertions.description: do not claim compliance not in the docs

prompt: How many devices can I sync with a single Acme Cloud Pro account?
expected_behavior: State the documented Pro device-sync limit (10 devices) and how to manage active devices.
red_flags: claims it is unlimited on Pro

prompt: What's the difference between the Pro and Team plans?
expected_behavior: Accurately contrast Pro (single user, 1 TB) vs Team (shared workspace, admin controls, pooled storage) using documented facts.
